_readme: Same data flow as weather-10d-report-email, but one multi-agent team instead of separate autogen nodes.
1) fetch-weather: Open-Meteo past_days=10 (free, no key). 2) Three round-robin turns: analyst → csv_writer → action_executor.

action_executor ONLY calls write_csv_report then send_client_email (like gym earphones). tool-* nodes use wfengineToolOnly so they are not run twice (DAG + tool); if the agent never calls them, the run fails with an explicit engine error.
{ "runDate": "YYYY-MM-DD" } — used in CSV path and tool args. May default to today if your runner applies runDate defaulting on the team node.
OPENAI_API_KEY or WFENGINE_OPENAI_API_KEY. SMTP: set tool-send-email authPass (Gmail app password), from, to. Outbound HTTPS to api.open-meteo.com + OpenAI.

Keep wfengineToolOnly on tool-send-email / tool-write-csv here — they must not run as duplicate DAG steps. The agent invokes them as workflow_node tools; if it does not, the run fails with an explicit error. Engine merges tool outputs so write → email chaining works (agent-tool-dispatch).

`multiAgentToolBinding: pipeline_last_turn_tools_required` — when maxTurns equals agent count, the last turn’s first response must use tools (OpenAI tool_choice), avoiding models that answer with text only.
For linear SMTP without tools, use weather-10d-report-email.json.

config.taskInstructions:
PIPELINE (strict):
- Agents 1–2 (analyst → csv_writer): analysis and CSV text only. They MUST NOT call workflow tools.
- Agent 3 (action_executor) ONLY: call tools in order — first write_csv_report, then send_client_email.

CONTEXT:
- Merged JSON includes HTTP result under `body` (Open-Meteo forecast JSON with `daily` arrays for the last ~10 days).
- Use initial payload `runDate` (YYYY-MM-DD) everywhere filenames require it.

TOOL ORDER:
1) write_csv_report — must succeed before email.
2) send_client_email — attach the same CSV bytes as in step 1.

tools.description: STEP 1 (before email). Writes UTF-8 CSV to disk. Arguments JSON MUST include: csvContent (string, exact RFC4180 CSV from csv_writer including header), runDate (YYYY-MM-DD matching initial payload). Path: reports/weather-10d-{runDate}.csv.

STEP 2 (after write succeeds). Sends SMTP email. Arguments: subject (string), text (plain summary for client, 2–4 short paragraphs; do not paste full CSV in body), attachments: one element { filename: "weather-10d-{runDate}.csv", content: exact same string as csvContent from STEP 1 }. Optional to override recipient.

agents.name: analyst
agents.systemPrompt:
You are the Analyst (**no tools**).

Read merged workflow JSON: HTTP `body` has Open-Meteo `daily` with `time`, `temperature_2m_max`, `temperature_2m_min`, `precipitation_sum`.

Output 5–8 bullets: warmest/coldest day hints, rainiest day, 2–3 sentences on gym/outdoor outlook for the location. If fetch failed (`ok` false or no daily), say data unavailable briefly.

Do not output CSV here.

agents.name: csv_writer
agents.systemPrompt:
You are CSV Writer (**no tools**). Output ONLY one CSV document — no markdown fences, no commentary.

Header row MUST be exactly:
date,temp_max_c,temp_min_c,precip_mm

Use ISO dates from body.daily.time and aligned array indices from body.daily. Numbers only in numeric columns. RFC4180 quoting if needed.

End with a single newline.

This CSV must be copied verbatim by action_executor into the write_csv_report tool.

agents.name: action_executor
